verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document AI-generated summaries of incidents or alert context for responders. Grafana Cloud lists AI capabilities ('Grafana Assistant, Investigations'), but only by name, with no description of incident or alert summarization. Knowledge Graph 'insights' and the natural-language exploration claims are related features rather than incident summaries, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders
